section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Brazilian Figure Rating Scale (FRS) for children, an instrument validated by Kakeshita (2008) for Brazilian children aged 7 to 12. It details the scale's composition of 11 silhouettes for each sex, ranging in BMI, and explains how it is used to assess perceptual body image and body dissatisfaction in Study X.
